description:
Spacious semi-detached home in a village location with two double bedrooms and a first-floor bathroom. Featuring a living room, dining room, and a kitchen breakfast room, this property offers ample living space for a comfortable lifestyle. The large rear garden includes a detached garage, while the front garden and driveway provide plenty of parking space.

Enjoy stunning views over the Solway towards Criffel, with the Lake District visible from the front garden. Nestled in the picturesque village of Newton Arlosh, within the Solway Coast designated an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty, this property offers a tranquil setting. The village boasts a welcoming community, with local amenities including the inviting Joiners Arms pub and the esteemed Nelson Thomlinson School in Wigton.

Nearby towns of Wigton and Carlisle provide additional conveniences just a short distance away. Don't miss the chance to own this charming property in a beautiful village setting. Contact us today to arrange a viewing.

Directions Newton Arlosh is on the B5307 Carlisle to Silloth road. From Carlisle, leave the city on Newtown Road, (past the Cumberland Infirmary), then Moorhouse Road (B5307). Continue over the western city bypass, for approx. 9 miles, turning right on the Wigton bypass (A596), signposted Kirkbride, to remain on the B5307. Take the left turning for Newton Arlosh, turning into the village past the pub. The property is located on the right-hand side, on the western edge of the village.

Services Oil powered central heating with mains electric, water and drains being connected. Neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
